Dear [Mr Innes](/person/744)
Many thanks for the [Cheque](/topic/160)- I understand it as £40 for the half year’s editorship, and £10 for the subeditor - [Miss Finlaison](/person/512).

The Christmas no for which I have always had £10 for Editorship, stands I suppose upon a different foot. I believe I sent you all the addresses. I had a letter from my cousin

[Miss Crawley Boevey](/person/381)[^1]
Flaxley Cottage, Newnham
Gloucestershire,

asking me about it

I think everyone will rejoice if you can make the wrapper more blue

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: CMY was related to the Crawley Boeveys through her paternal grandmother Catharina Crawley.

Sybella Crawley Boevey (d. 1911), daughter of CMY’s second cousin Sir Thomas Crawley-Boevey, 4th Bt., had contributed \'A Love picture in three strokes\' MP (Christmas 1890), 234-45.
